title: News Reflection: Malacañang does not like the word ‘nilaglag’
summary: Is President Marcos throwing his cousin Martin Romualdez under the bus?

blocks.text: Is President Marcos throwing his cousin Martin Romualdez under the bus?

Was former House speaker Martin Romualdez “nilaglag” — thrown under the bus, made into the fall guy — by his cousin, Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr., by letting him be charged with plunder over the flood control corruption scandal? Palace spokeswoman Claire Castro begs to disagree.
Here is this week’s News Reflection with Paterno Esmaquel II. – Rappler.com
